{{Quote|All my life, people have been judging me by my size&mdash;|Toki Tollivar|<ref name="kotor38" />}}
'''Toki Tollivar''' was a [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|Bimm]] who worked in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Ministry of Commerce/Legends|Ministry of Commerce]] during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] and was often underestimated due to his small physical appearance. Thus, when his [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitivity]] brought him into consideration for training by the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Empire]], he seized the opportunity to be trained in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. By the war's end, Tollivar had only progressed in status to that of a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]], at which time he began his own private campaign of murder across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

Tollivar styled himself as a [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-strangling]] serial killer as he ran amok and capitalized on the diminutive stature he felt so often ridiculed for. The trail of throttled bodies caused Tollivar to eventually settle on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] under the alias '''Kelven Garnatrope''', though his appetite for murder was far from sated. Dubbed by the public as the '''Corellian Strangler''', Tollivar fled the planet before authorities could connect him with the murders, purchasing a ride on board the ''[[Chancellor Fillorean]]'' [[Luxury yacht/Legends|luxury yacht]] into the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].

Tollivar was discovered several weeks later on the ''Fillorean'' hiding amongst a shipload of corpses by [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zayne Carrick]] and the crew of the ''[[Hot Prospect]]''. After attempting to strangle several of the ''Prospect''{{'s}} crewmembers, Tollivar was found out by Carrick, with whom he engaged in a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] [[Duel on the Chancellor Fillorean|duel]]. The Sith adept defeated his enemy but was restrained by his own [[Service droid/Legends|servant droid]], [[K-OB7]], and subsequently killed by the [[Zeltron/Legends|Zeltron]] [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol]], who at the time had been secretly under disguise as Carrick's crew-mate, [[Mandalorian Crusaders|Mandalorian Crusader]] [[Rohlan Dyre]].

==Biography==
===Sith adept===
{{Quote|A lowly ''Sith adept'' in the commerce ministry! I was the perfect assassin&mdash;but the war ended.|Toki Tollivar|<ref name="kotor38" />}}
[[File:Toki_Tollivar.jpg|thumb|left|170px|Toki Tollivar in 3963 BBY]]
Toki Tollivar was a [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|Bimm]] citizen of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Diminutive in stature, Tollivar believed that other [[Sentience/Legends|beings]] underestimated him due to his size. However, Tollivar found that some sects respected power regardless of the size of its wielder. Such was the case with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], whose attention was grabbed by Tollivar's strong [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitivity]]. When they offered Tollivar an opportunity to be trained in the ways of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] through Sith teachings, the Bimm readily accepted. He became a [[Sith acolyte/Legends|Sith Acolyte]] and was put into service during the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]], where he managed to slay many [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] opponents. He was also installed as an employee within the Republic [[Ministry of Commerce/Legends|Ministry of Commerce]], where he acted as an [[Sith assassin/Legends|assassin]] on behalf of the Sith.<ref name="kotor38" />

After the war's end and the defeat of [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]],<ref name="tsw6">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 6|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 6]]</ref> Tollivar was left without an [[Sith Empire (Exar Kun)/Legends|Empire]] to fight for and no [[Brotherhood of the Sith|Order]] from which to receive instruction. Knowing that the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the Republic were intent on cleansing all vestiges of Sith influence from the galaxy, Tollivar went into hiding, taking on a string of aliases. He started his own business while maintaining employment with the Commerce Ministry, where he could continue his own personal campaign of revenge against those whom he felt judged him by his minuscule proportions. Tollivar remained underground for the next thirty years, during which time he acquired a [[Service droid/Legends|servant droid]] called [[K-OB7]]. "Kayo", as referred to by Tollivar, was programmed to protect its Bimm owner no matter the cost. The two became friendly, and Kayo stayed with Tollivar, attending to both his personal and business needs.<ref name="kotor38" />

===Foul play===
{{Quote|&hellip;And I was never around when it happened. Master ''must'' have been part of it&mdash;but how ''could'' he? ''He's too small''&hellip;|K-OB7|<ref name="kotor38" />}}
Tollivar's droid became suspicious of his owner when it chanced upon one of Tollivar's business associates, a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], strangled to [[Death/Legends|death]] on the premises of his establishment. Tollivar was indeed responsible, having [[Telekinesis/Legends|Force-choked]] his victim, but he denied any involvement in the murder. Instead of reporting the crime and potentially bringing negative publicity to his business, Tollivar disposed of the body, and the secret remained hidden with him and the droid. A year later, another strangled body was found in Tollivar's vicinity, and the count continued to rise&mdash;all while the short-statured Bimm swore ignorance to any knowledge of foul play. To mislead the authorities, however, Tollivar adopted the name "Kelven Garnatrope" and settled on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].<ref name="kotor38" />

For a time, Tollivar successfully eluded officials while he engaged in a private killing spree. [[Bounty/Legends|Bounties]] were posted for the "Corellian Strangler", and [[Hologram/Legends|holoimages]] of Kelven Garnatrope changed from day to day.<ref name="tc">{{KOTORbackups|23}}</ref><ref name="tott">{{KOTORbackups|20}}</ref> Even Tollivar's closest companion, Kayo, was uncertain of the Bimm's innocence and was conflicted in the possibility that a being so small was capable of strangling larger individuals. When the Corellians finally began to associate Garnatrope with Tollivar, he fled again, purchasing a place on a thirty-passenger cruise through the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] on board a [[Luxury yacht/Legends|luxury yacht]] called the ''[[Chancellor Fillorean]]''.<ref name="kotor38" />

===Jedi rescue===
{{Quote|Who&mdash;who are ''you''?"<br />"''Toki Tollivar''. A passenger&mdash;the ''last'' one.|Zayne Carrick meets Toki Tollivar|<ref name="kotor38" />}}
[[File:Toki-Jarael.jpg|thumb|right|170px|Tollivar Force-chokes Jarael.]]
It was not long before Tollivar's murderous pattern emerged on the ''Fillorean'', as well. Crew and passengers alike died one by one, each Force-strangled by Tollivar. The ship ended up stranded and adrift in the Core Worlds [[Nebula/Legends|nebulae]] for weeks until it was chanced upon by Jedi [[Zayne Carrick]] and the crew of the ''[[Hot Prospect]]''. According to Tollivar, some unknown tragedy had befallen all of the ship's passengers save he and his servant droid. One of the ''Prospect''{{'s}} crewmen, the [[Mandalorian Crusaders|Mandalorian Crusader]] [[Demagol]], who was masquerading as [[Rohlan Dyre]], discovered part of the truth&mdash;that each of the ''Fillorean''{{'s}} passengers had died from asphyxiation. The Bimm's droid was the primary suspect, as the ''Hot Prospect''{{'s}} crew did not believe that such a small being as Tollivar was capable of killing larger individuals. Carrick assured Tollivar of his safety, while the Jedi and his crewmen set about restoring the ''Fillorean''{{'s}} systems and preparing for it to be rescued.<ref name="kotor38" />

While they continued to unravel the circumstances behind the mysterious ''Fillorean'' murders, one of the ''Prospect''{{'s}} crew, a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] called [[Slyssk]], was Force-asphyxiated by Tollivar and left for dead. Slyssk was found soon thereafter by the [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]]-[[Arkanian Offshoot/Legends|offshoot]] [[Jarael]], and Dyre performed an emergency field tracheotomy to save the Trandoshan. Tollivar then appeared, seemingly unaware of what had transpired, and was ordered to remain in the care of Jarael while Carrick and Dyre pursued the Bimm's servant droid for questioning. Once they were alone, he fell upon Jarael, revealing his Sith status as he levitated and began strangling her. His plan was to commandeer the ''Hot Prospect'' and continue his murder spree one Republic citizen at a time. Tollivar would have succeeded in killing Jarael had Carrick not arrived and incapacitated him with [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire. Reveling at the opportunity to again face a Jedi in combat, Tollivar ignited his [[red]]-bladed [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and engaged Carrick in a [[Duel on the Chancellor Fillorean|duel]].<ref name="kotor38" />

===Downfall===
{{Quote|You won't stop me! I'll destroy them all! The Jedi&mdash;the woman&mdash;''especially'' the woman! Wherever they go, I'll find them! ''I'll finish what I started!''|Tollivar's last words|<ref name="kotor38" />}}
[[File:Toki_death.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The death of Tollivar]]
Despite his height disadvantage, Tollivar dominated his opponent from the onset of the brief [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]]. He ended the contest when he wrenched a lighting fixture free with the Force and struck Carrick with it. The Bimm Sith stood over his defeated opponent preparing to finish him, when Tollivar's droid, Kayo, restrained its owner in an attempt to prevent Tollivar from further endangering himself. He tried to resist the droid's maneuver, even striking him with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]],<ref name="DHBoards">{{DHBoards|subdomain=boards|url=viewtopic.php?t=15211&start=15|thread=KOTOR #38 -- Ghost ship!|user=[[John Jackson Miller]]|time=17:47|quote=The idea was that it was to be force lightning -- a weird little echo of Vader seizing the Emperor -- but that hitting a droid would probably throw off its own energy. We figured it worked either way.}}</ref> and vowed to continue his murderous rampage. Rohlan Dyre took the Bimm seriously and shot Tollivar and the droid, destroying them both. The Corellian Strangler was finally dead,<ref name="kotor38" /> leaving a considerable amount of [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credits]] in bounty to be claimed by Carrick and his company.<ref name="kotor48">[[Knights of the Old Republic 48|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 48]]</ref>

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Now, I finish the Republic one citizen at a time. I may not help the Sith rise again&mdash;but bless me, I ''do'' enjoy it.|Toki Tollivar, on murder|<ref name="kotor38" />}}
[[File:TokiTollivarForceLightning-KOTOR38.jpg|170px|thumb|Toki Tollivar using Force lightning on his own droid]]
Toki Tollivar was a scorned being, angered by those whom he felt stereotyped him by his [[Species/Legends|species]]' petite size and unassuming appearance,<ref name="aa">''[[Alien Anthology]]''</ref> rather than his own knowledge and abilities. He used their underestimations of him to further his own Sith-inspired goals. Tollivar felt that those with power deserved respect without discrimination.<ref name="kotor38" />

After the Great Sith War, Tollivar displayed a thirst for murder. He found that killing beings brought him temporary satisfaction; upon the death of his first victim, he realized that his need to kill was insatiable, and he embarked on a path that led to a long string of serial murders.<ref name="kotor38" />

Tollivar was also a dishonest being; he lied about his involvement to his droid upon the discovery of the initial strangled body, and later to the crew of the ''Hot Prospect'' with regards to the deaths on board the ''Chancellor Fillorean''. To deceive authorities, Tollivar adopted several aliases, hoping to distance himself from any potential investigation into his murderous activities. When false images of his aliases surfaced in the media, Tollivar did nothing to sway the misdirection of the authorities, instead capitalizing on their ignorance by continuing to kill. Rather than be apprehended, Tollivar fled into space hoping to deaden the trail that inevitably led to him.<ref name="kotor38" />

==Powers and abilities==
{{Quote|This gets better and better. I haven't killed a proper Jedi in years.|Toki Tollivar, to Zayne Carrick|<ref name="kotor38" />}}
[[File:Toki_lightsaber.png|thumb|200x200px|Tollivar wielding his lightsaber|left]]
Toki Tollivar was a Force-sensitive being of considerable strength. As a Sith adept, he was fond of using Force choke to throttle individuals. He was able to project blasts of Force lightning, though not in a capacity sufficient enough to hinder his droid K-OB7 from attempting to subdue him. He was also able to keep his identity as the Corellian Strangler hidden for quite some time through deceptions and prompt exits from the scenes of his various crimes.<ref name="kotor38" />

Tollivar was proficient with a lightsaber, wielding a diminished [[Shoto lightsaber/Legends|shoto]]-styled weapon with the crimson blade of a Sith. Tollivar possessed a talent for [[Dun Möch/Legends|Dun Möch]], displayed when he Force-hurled debris at Jedi Zayne Carrick while they dueled on the ''Chancellor Fillorean''. The Bimm Sith was able to defeat Carrick in their contest, though he was overcome by first his droid Kayo, followed by Rohlan Dyre, who destroyed both Tollivar and Kayo with his blaster pistol.<ref name="kotor38" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|I love the range of emotions Dean gives Toki. Like with Yoda, you wouldn't expect to get that many expressions out of a little muppet&hellip;!|John Jackson Miller's thoughts on Dean Zachary's artistry|<ref name="JJM">{{Faraway|url=comics/swknights/swkotor38.html|text=''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic #38''}}</ref>}}
[[File:Toki_b_9_5-copy.gif|thumb|right|160px|Concept of Tollivar's concealed lightsaber]]
Toki Tollivar was created by [[John Jackson Miller]] for the thirty-eighth installment of the [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic (comic series)|''Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic'' comic series]], titled [[Knights of the Old Republic 38|''Faithful Execution'']]. Jackson Miller planted several reports of a notorious serial killer, the ''Corellian Strangler'', in previous issues of ''Knights of the Old Republic'': [[Knights of the Old Republic 14|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 14]], [[Knights of the Old Republic 20|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 20]], [[Knights of the Old Republic 23|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 23]]. The "Strangler" appeared not in the actual comics, but in the ''Adjudicator'' holofeeds that were included in them, where the identity&mdash;even the species&mdash;of the "Strangler" was deliberately obscured.<ref name="tc" /><ref name="tott" /><ref name="tor">{{KOTORbackups|14}}</ref> Some two years after the "Strangler's" initial mention, Jackson Miller explained on his website that he felt ''Faithful Execution'' was the appropriate issue to reveal Tollivar as the "Strangler", thus ending the mystery of "Strangler's" identity. Jackson Miller continued to discuss ''Faithful Execution'', and also expressed his satisfaction that artist [[Dean Zachary]] was contracted for the issue, as he considered Zachary's style of "dark and moody" artistry to be ideal for the storyline.<ref name="JJM" />

When ''Faithful Execution'' was released, readers were under the impression that the Mandalorian character was indeed Rohlan Dyre, having previously been given no reason to believe otherwise. It is later revealed in [[Knights of the Old Republic 47|the first issue]] of the ''Knights of the Old Republic'' story arc [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic: Demon|''Demon'']] that Dyre was being impersonated by the Mandalorian [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Demagol]].<ref name="kotor47">[[Knights of the Old Republic 47|''Knights of the Old Republic'' 47]]</ref>
